title: calculateTotal calls list_ids() instead of COUNT(*)
description: In kith-chat/src/chat.rs ChatQueryHandler, when calculateTotal=true, the handler calls guard.chats().list_ids() (line 500-505) which fetches ALL chat IDs into a Vec<String> just to call .len() on it. For a user with many chats this is O(n) memory allocation and a full table scan when a COUNT(*) SQL query would be O(1). The store already has a pattern for count-via-SQL (unread_count uses COUNT(*)). A new store method like count_chats() -> Result<usize, KithError> executing SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chats would eliminate the allocation entirely.
